summary: Client one-frame event on a cluster child (world object grouped into a streaming cluster) whose cluster changed. Written by ls::ClusterSystem::ProcessMovedChilds (GameEngine.dll+0x137D70): when a moved child leaves its cluster, the system moves it from the old cluster's content to the new one, then sets this component to {old cluster, new cluster} and stores the new cluster into the child's ClusterChildComponent. Read by phx::PhysXDisableSimulationSystem::ProcessChangedClusters. Seen alive in many dialogs/events (objects moved during scenes).

fields.name: OldCluster
fields.evidence: GameEngine.dll+0x137D70 lines 341-344: gets the event through GameEngine.dll+0x12A9D0 (with the view and the child) and writes the current ClusterChild value (the previous cluster entity) at +0 of the event just before ClusterChild is overwritten with the new one. Game creator bg3.exe+0x3E5FA40 allocates 0x10 bytes and writes the null handle. Live entity handles.

fields.name: NewCluster
fields.evidence: same lines: writes at +8 of the event the cluster the child is moved to (also written into ClusterChildComponent). Game default null handle. Live entity handles.

open_questions: GameEngine.dll+0x12A9D0 was taken to be the add/get of this component from the surrounding view (not opened).
